text: The food isn't that good compared to the other restaurants I've patronized in Santa Barbara.  No doubt this place had the best sitting area and ambience.  But the food wasn't that great.  Service was ok, the server didn't clear our tables after we were done having our appetizer and entree.
Super solid pizza, salads and meatball parms. This is what we order and it is always great!
These cheesesteaks are LOADED with meat  I recommend the corn nuggets as a side. They are banging!

Had a Covid pick up and can say I just love this place. Had a mix of dishes and all were really nicely done, a mix of traditional and new. The menu says simply Chicken Wings as an appetizer. These are a half dozen fried wings with a spicy Thai sauce and sesame seeds. Just the right burn for all heat level lovers. The Larb Gai salad with chicken is a spicy, citrusy flavor explosion. Sweet, spicy, sour....just get it. I asked for the Red Curry to be made spicy.....and boy was it, and brims with a wonderful curry flavor and is chock full veggies and chicken. Pad Thai was ordered not spicy and hit the spot, even for teens. People there are so nice as a bonus.

Just went to eat there and they are supposed to open at 12 but sign says 12:30. Fine we can wait. 12:30 comes and the worker says that the cook didn't show and they need another 20 minutes. I will take my money elsewhere. Disappointing

Great experience on a Saturday night. The staff was extremely courteous while accommodating our double stroller and kids. In downtown Nashville, that's not always a thing. Aside from that, our service was as great. Food was outstanding, dishes cleared away promptly. The doorman was very kind as well. It's obvious management has a healthy culture and winning standards in place. Band was excellent. Will return!

The food was really good. Today they actually had there ac first time this place has been cold all year. I don't know if the AC is been broken or they've been just trying to save that money on electric but today was a good day in pho 97. I didn't sweat through my shirt eating my soup today or have to eat outside. Thank u pho 97 and please keep the ac going while u serve hot soups. I will be coming back.

15 minute wait which wasn't bad and the food was delicious but slow and inefficient service. Waitress didn't  bring cream with my coffee and she didn't offer water or coffee refills. Didn't offer a to go container either.  We had to ask for all!  Probably won't be back although the food was good.

Brand new to the area and already eaten here twice. Only negative I have is that they only do reservations for tables of 4 or more, leaving groups smaller than that fighting for tables on a busy night which to me is frustrating. That said, the mussels and plentiful varieties were pretty awesome! Cajun and white wine mussels were excellent. Also tried fish and chips there that had lots of flavor. Overall great experience just wish they'd take a reservation for a table of 2-3.

I love this place.
The staff is always friendly, and always willing to show ppl new to hotpot how to do it. The broth selection is great, I always get the pork bone.

The dipping sauces are good, all the classic choices are available. The house special sauce is so good, sweet and vinegary with a hint of sesame.

The buffet choices are great. My favorite were the beef balls and tofu selections. The dumplings are ON POINT!
Pro tip: cook your dumplings in the soup for a min, then put them on the grill to finish cooking. Boiiiiiiiii.

The meat is endless, but the lamb is where you get your money's worth. Sliced super thin, and tender, as long as you dont over cook it.

Get the BBQ addition to really enjoy everything.

This was my first hotpot experience, and created a hotpot monster out of me. Don't pass this place up.
So many sweet treat options with their ice cream and they have the best prices on the island!!

A great little dive for lunch! I had the enchiladas verde and a tasty horchata! Service was great and that crew works hard to make delicious food. This is a counter and a free extra seats, so it's a tight squeeze. Definitely recommend!
10/10 service love this place and these people!!! John is the best bartender! Love love love this place and the food is unbeatable get the sweet potato tots!

Sunday and don't know what to do... go to Kona Grill for happy hour!!! This is one of the best happy  hours I have yet to find in Indy! 

The happy hour menu has drinks and food and is broken into dollar value categories to pick from. There's items such as margs, beer, wine..: sushi, sliders, tacos, etc. 

The absolute best item are the avocado egg rolls- you have to try these!!! I highly recommend them. 

The sliders were always our second favorite but sadly they changed the portions and dropped the fries- items may change like this which is the only major downside. The slider portions are less and no fries for the same price, I preferred the larger two with fries so a little sad here!

The sushi is also amazing and there are several rolls to pick from. 

Happy hour is also during the week just limited hours, Sunday is all day!

Waited in line for about 15 mins to order. No big deal since I know how slow McDonald's is. Even though 2 cars were next to each other blocking anyone from coming or going.... that's another story.  Finally at the window and give the employee my card. Then 3 minutes later another employee opens the window and has her arm out waiting on me for something. I ask what? And then she sticks her head out of the window and says well everybody else has to pay for their food. What makes you so special?? Thankfully another employee tells her I have already given my card and they are waiting for the first employee to walk bk to the first window to pay for it and then come bk to the second window. I finally got half my meal and she told me to go. Not have a nice day but to go. After that I had to ask for the rest of my order which I payed for and not yet received. A couple minutes passed and the rest of my meal was given to me. Then they have the audacity to ask what I'm still waiting for.  Um my credit card would be great to get back. This is ridiculous.

Arrogant beyond belief!
I took my husband here for his birthday.  It was his first time in New Orleans and I was excited to nab a reservation on 6pm Fri April 26th during Jazzfest weekend (our reason for being here).

Well - we were beyond disappointed.  Had never experienced such arrogance from a waiter. Not to be expected in what I thought was a top notch dining experience.

First indication - in reviewing the wine list I asked for a taste of one of the wines before selecting. We commonly do this, but the response I received from the head waiter was a bit of a snicker, a questioning laugh that came across as - what, you don't trust us?

Then came time to order.  The waiter had run through the menu earlier including the soup of the day.  We decided to try several things, including the alligator and the 1-1-1 soup tasting.  When I asked how is the soup of the day prepared, the waiter (impatiently) said "Like I said before, the soup is prepared xyz way).  Now - there was no need to point out that I didn't remember the first round of description.

We asked about the vegetables of the day, how they were prepared, etc and both my husband and I said - ok that  sounds good (or something similar) and by our response we thought we were ordering them.  But when the food arrived no vegetables.  I mentioned to the server (not the head waiter) that we were expecting the vegetables.  So the server mentioned this to the head waiter.  The head waiter said - loud enough for us to hear him -

Gave this restaurant 3 chances.  First time my order was wrong and no apologies when I returned to make it right.  Second time was mediocre and Mac salad was old and I threw away.  Third time just this week they didn't have the simple musubi order claiming a spam shortage and that the price of spam was too high but they'd have it tomorrow.  3 times 3 fails

I ordered delivery while in Indianapolis for work, and I have to say I do not understand the positive reviews, at least for delivery. The delivery was almost 20 minutes later than estimated. The price was high (25$) including tip and delivery for what I got. I ordered spicy feta fries, a salad, and stuffed grape leaves, with a side of tzatziki. Everything was lukewarm. The fries were tasty but soggy. The salad was fine, but mostly romaine, and the grape leaves were covered in a disgustingly congealed lemon sauce. Very disappointing. There was no complimentary pita included, but I could not eat the tzatziki anyway, as I felt the temperature was unsafe.

The chicken cutlet sandwich (add rabe and long hots) is the stuff of dreams. The gnocchi are like little potato clouds. Everything I've ever ordered from here has been so, so good, and the staff/owners are really chill.

I like the place but their food is uninspiring. The one thing that bugged me most was all the dead bugs in the window sill. We have been there twice recently and they have not wiped the windowsills. Where you sit, that is your view. They seem like they turn over a lot of staff. I wish some would stay on. Gets to have a "not so friendly" atmosphere when you don't recognize the servers or the customers. With a few spruce ups and item edits, this could be a place to be!

Super delicious sandwiches although I'm not gonna lie, a bit steep in price. It's a once in a while treat for me only because I can't afford a $15 sandwich lunch daily. Sometimes drive by, salivate and rush home to make myself a copy cat version that's never as good! Highly recommend otherwise. Ps- skip the garlic bread option it's too oily/greasy makes sammy soggy!

This place is one of my favorites in Reno. I recommend this for anyone that wants to have a fun dinner and a show. Madison was a phenomenal waitress, she explained the menu to us and made everyone feel at home. Walter, our chef, was extremely talented and cooked everything to perfection. He has some tricks up his sleeve that made the experience that much more special!

This was my second visit here. First time by myself and this time with a group of 4. So first the yays: oysters... amazing, lovely variety. Overall main dishes were great. Trout was delicious swimming in a bit of broth. Caviar was also delicious and partnered with yummy accoutrements. Service was excellent from start to finish. I called at around 7pm and asked to be seated for 7:30. The gentlemen who took my call assured us seating. when we arrived I was greeted by someone else but he recognized my voice and came right over to help us out. That's what I consider excellent service! Server was also excellent, very friendly and attentive. Now the nays: unfortunately they seemed to have run out many of the things we requested, after one glass of wine for one of us, it was no longer available. Same for the second choice. No coffee was available as machine was down. Finally the swordfish is partnered with Brussel sprouts which is a poor choice for this fish as it becomes overwhelmingly a Brussel sprout dish and destroys the flavor or the fish itself. A stronger flavored fish would have been a much better choice to pair with the sprouts. Without the service being so good, the other issues would definitely bring my rating to a 3 instead of a 4. I would consider dining here again however, since nothing was truly bad.

I'm rating this one experience I'm having right now. Not the entire restaurant & will try more pizza from here. Just not this horrible spicy garlic. Omg. I'm eating it because it cost me $9 & I haven't eaten all day. 

Walking to my car, I spot the truck in Love Park, I make an instant detour. I haven't eaten from here in years, but I remembered thinking the margherita was the best I've had outside of Italy. 

So, I made the fatal mistake of trying something new. I love spicy food & garlic. I couldn't resist! It's. So. Bad. Look at the picture. There's hardly any cheese & what's there is singed. The garlic is singed. The spice is perfect though. But ughhh, what an expensive disappointment.

Tried them because I saw they just opened and wanted to try a new sushi spot. The fish wasn't terribly fresh and had a "fishy" taste. The raw fish was also warm which kind of ruined the freshness. They also had rolls that had clashing flavors. I think a lot of them would have been better without blue crab which they seem to like to add. The rolls are a decent size and well priced.

The tortillas and guacamole are very good. 

I have an issue with the man behind the counter having his mask pulled down even though there is a sign on the door stating that masks are required for customers. All 3 customers inside had their masks on.  I almost did not go in but parking was a pain so I decided to anyway. 

It's also obnoxious that he asked me to use Venmo instead of card. Merchant fees are tiny. Give me a break. Just do cash only then, maybe they do I'm not sure.
Stopped in because I heard the cheese steaks were good. Probably the best I've had in Philly. 1) quality meat; and 2) THE BREAD IS SO GOOD
Our waitress was great! Her name was Sam. She was very personable and we appreciated her friendly personality.
Great food! Wonderful service. Loved it! I had the mole negro oaxaconeuro and it was absolutely delicious. Everything came out hot and fast. It was an absolute delight to eat at this restaurant.

I am disappointed with them. I ordered pickup this past week and paid over the phone to avoid a lot of contact. They advertise that they are practicing social distancing. However, when I arrived, the place was packed. There was no social distancing going on. I had to go inside and wait about 15 mins in a crowded area to get my food. I used to go there often and ordered for curbside pick up several times during the past couple of months with no problem. Not anymore. After this experience, I told one of friends who said she experienced the same thing on a different night. I wish we had talked earlier. If you are looking for a place that respects social distancing guidelines, don't go there or order for pickup from them because you will find yourself in a situation you don't want to be in. Once this is over, I may consider going back because the food is good, but there are other places with good food in Saint Louis.

Awesome service! We were immediately greeted by staff. We sat at the bar and were served mere moments after sitting down and got two excellent glasses of wine!

Although we didn't order any food this time, we had an amazing experience. We will certainly be back soon to enjoy their other offerings!
Great Pizza!!  Cauliflower crust with spicy pepperoni is very good.  Recommend.

Just okay at best. A bit bland and luke warm. For the amount of reviews that this place has it didn't hold up for the hype. The waitress didn't seem as though she enjoyed her job but the waitress that wasn't our server was helping us more than our actual waitress. Don't go out of your way for this place. Unless you like just ok food and service.

I have been to the mile several times and always enjoy the food thoroughly . Everything is always full of flavor and fresh and they have a rather large menu selection..My last visit was not good ..everything we had both of our sandwiches had no flavor and just tasted like grease .. and I was so un satisfied I didn't even finish half of my meal..and when we politely mentioned that the food wasn't to good and were surprised because it usually is ..the waitress kinda just laughed it off and didn't think it was a big deal..probably won't be coming back to the mile for food for a while

Great beachside food: wIll definitely go back to Padaro Beach Grill. We had fish tacos and chili fries - food tasted great! Menu has something for a variety of preferences (tacos, sandwiches, burgers) and everything was prepared fresh. And ice cream sandwiches or milkshakes to top it all off. 

All outdoor seating which is perfect for social distancing! Great place to stop for a quick bite during a road trip or after spending the afternoon at the beach. For casual dining, this place is great.

Food is hit or miss, ether phenomenal or sub par. I went tonight and they were very unorganized and unfriendly. The cashier caught an attitude with me and didn't like my response, so she physically threw all my food in the bag and then threw the bag on the counter. Asked for extra mayo and there was barely any on there. Wife's plain cheesesteak had onions.

We were a party of eight this morning. The food and service was great. However, we were eight people sitting at a 10 top table. Two random men sat at our table during our meal. They sat themselves since it was busy and they were anxious to not wait. They got up and told the waitress where they were and she began to serve them. While I understand it was busy and they were trying to make the best of the seating arrangements, it was awkward and a bit unprofessional. The waitress could have warned us that other people would be joining our group. The table  is one long table so they felt as if they were part of our party. They also make people get up and pay. Normally this would be okay at most diners, but there was no space in there. The line was through the back of the restaurant. Between the crowding to pay and the two people that joined our table, we were anxious to leave.

As a vegetarian, I'm so glad I found this gem! I eat here once a month when I go to Nashville. Staff is consistently friendly and the salad bar is always filled with fresh sides. The dressing choices are great too.
I was so happy when this restaurant opened a few years ago they have some of the best food around I highly recommend if you want to try something new no no

The foods always good there, but service was awful--new GM doesn't look like he knows what he's doing, and amidst the coronavirus pandemic he didn't even bother to wear gloves while handing out the drinks and taking payment. Nasty stuff.

This place use to be good. You might as well order dinner at breakfast--because that's how long it takes them to bring the food out. The servers are over extended the food is ok at best and because you have to wait  1 hour or more for your food with your young kids the experience becomes hellish. After 5 plus years I can assure you we won't be coming back.

Follow through. Kids love the place we went back, they offered us a gift certificate which I have not used. Service has gotten much better.
Nicely priced for its value. Special events or special occasions, this place for grandsons event. Great service from wait staff and knowledgeable wine sommelier.

I wish I could add more stars to this review! A few months ago one of my students gifted me with a cupcake from Bittersweet Confections and I fell in love! The cake and the icing were so flavorful and moist which is really important to me. With that being said I've decided to get my birthday cake from them but before doing so I wanted to try a few other flavors. Without surprise every other flavor was just as delicious as the very first one I decided to get. Which has only made it harder for me to choose. I'll spin the wheel and whichever one I get is the one I'll order because Im certain it'll be delicious.
Classic Tampa staple restaurant!! Anything and everything on this menu is fabulous!! Including the staff!!!!!!
This is a pretty awesome place. Little gem. Can't speak to the rest of the menu because I only went for pho. Would recommend to anyone for pho though! :)

Usually love it here, but so disappointed today. Specifically asked waiter for wheat bread only(as usual-never an issue) and he brings us the usual. We only eat wheat and push the basket to edge of table and he says nothing. But, we were pretty neglected. Ordered the Monte Cristo sandwich, which put politely, tasted like . Both my daughter and I hated it. It took so long to get our food we didn't even bother to complain. It came out coated in "crispy corn flakes". I hate corn flakes and wouldn't have ordered had I known. I commented that it wasn't on the menu. The waiter agreed and brushed me off. My daughter felt like hers didn't have bacon on it. I had to reassemble mine(see pretty pic) so the eggs etc were actually between the slices of French toast. I'm going to have to have a serious come to Jesus before coming back here. I still feel sick to my stomach 4 hours later.
Great pizza good music and nice atmosphere. Plenty of outdoor seating and outdoor ordering in the back. Fun to watch the boats go in and out. Service was great.

Went there tonight, family of ten, and it was outstanding. They will seat up to 6 adults and kids. Our server Nicole could not have done a better job. She handled us like we were a party of four. She was out in front of everything a party of 10 could want or need. Drinks, plates, extra napkins, etc etc, she absolutely rocked. She helped us order and let us know they can do family style. Perfect evening.

Ok ladies and gentlemen we've been stopping a Frida's since early 2000's!!! I had to make a special trip just so I could review. Let me just say HELLO DELICIOUS FRESH BAKERY!!! Friendly staff, and welcoming environment. 
1. Chocolate Suicide 
2. Key lime 
3. Strawberry shortcake
4. Cheesecakes
5. Donuts
6. Coffee
7. Specialty coffee drinks
8. They SELL THEIR coffee
9. Mediterranean food for lunch
10. Soups

Those are only my top TEN reasons to go to FRIDAS BAKERY:) 

Run......go get something to enjoy!

This place isn't a typical 5 star kind of place to me but I give them a 5 star review bc they deserve it. We decided to try something new on Sunday after our jeep ride and stopped in to Tony's based on favorable Yelp reviews.  

We both had salads to start which came out with some crusty bread pieces and honey butter. What a yummy surprise!  I chose an Italian style salad with red onions and peppers in a vinaigrette dressing and my husband had a traditional salad with ranch. the lettuce was fresh and crisp, the dressing was good-great salad quality overall. 

For our entrees, I chose the chicken Parmesan which came with a side of pasta and I added grilled vegetables as well. My husband had a steak sandwich with their au gratin potatoes as his side.  My chicken was served with a bed of meat sauce covered pasta and was smothered in sauce and hot melted cheese. I liked the red sauce more than most places which IMO tend to be incredibly bland and/or too sweet tasting to me. And my grilled vegetables? They were awesome. Cooked to perfection with a dash of Cajun seasoning which really complemented the vegetables. They were so good I ate them all and had to take most of my chicken home. And my husband's meal? "That was honestly the best steak sandwich I've ever had" were his exact words. He even told people about it. Most steak sandwiches use lower grade thin steak. This was made out of filet so it was very meaty. Oh and those au gratin potatoes were obviously home made and were ver

Currently being poorly managed. Ran out of 2 of their 4 signature dishes, ran out of other items as well and substituted without asking. Didn't bring us our appetizer and no discounts or even apologetic. They post hours closing at 9 and turned at-least 10 people away, 3 different families who had arrived at 8:15. Every place along the strip was a 45 minute wait except Caddy's and now we know why. I hope they can turn it around because it's a nice location and has potential but they clearly need proper management.

My wife had picked Glory Days for place to go get dinner and watch some sports Friday night, I was reluctant because the last time we were here we had such bad service that it was a huge turn off. Well this past Friday we arrive and waited for a booth it took some time for our waitress to come by, but she did. Placed our drink and app order, it did not appear that they were overly busy. Some time passed and we realized that we had not received our drinks. We ordered a coke, Mich Ultra, Margarita and a specialty beer they had cinnamon and auger on the rim. Finally she brought the bulk of them except the Margarita. That arrived about five minutes later. This seemed to set the precedent for the evening. I wanted to say something but my wife didn't think it was right. When she decided to come back and take our food order, I was concerned with it being right. Twenty to twenty five minutes later it showed up except our nachos. The only meal that was hot was my grilled chicken and the nachos once they showed up. My wife's tacos and my other sons wings were cold. Mind you the Mgr did remove the cold meals, but I would rather have been enjoying the meals together. Then at one point the waitress said she is not sure what is going on in the kitchen, likely putting the blame on them to customers, bad move as a whole. I certainly hope they get their shit together and the waitress learn how not to blame others as well as how to be efficient with her guests. 

It will be a miracle if this i

Losers! A Coronavirus trap! Just drove by to get a burger. No go. NOT ONE person in the kitchen is wearing a mask above their nose. Most wearing masks beneath their mouths. Forget it. Don't go there if you are concerned about your life. They don't care. Nobody is following recommended guidelines. They all are disrespectful of my life and yours.  I'm finished with these jokers. Finished with Steak n Shake! Sayonara!

Normally I don't write bad reviews, but I felt like I had too. I got to Wingstop and told the employee that I had an online order , to start off the employee didn't even pay attention to me, she gave me my total, I payed her then she gave me my change. I didn't take much interest cause I saw that they were busy. I waited & my estimated wait time was 36-40 minutes as said online and I got to the store at 43 minutes, and my food still wasn't ready. I waited an extra 15 minutes just to get my food. when I went up to the counter to get my food I checked my bag and there was two brownies missing. I told the employee and she said she was going to give me a refund on the brownies but then she told me I had to pay 8 dollars extra when I had already paid for the food. I was confused & it turns out that the first employee took my money but forgot to cash it in the system so it looked like I didn't pay, I told the employee giving me my food what had happened and she told me she couldn't give me my money back, I got a coupon instead. I was upset but I let it slide but then I got home and realized that I had payed for ranch and it wasn't even in the bag :( !

Not impressed with service at all. We sat down and waited at least ten minutes before the waitress came. It didn't seem particularly busy. Placed our order. Ate our food. Our drinks were never refilled. When you pay 2.75 for a soda you should at least get a refill. Someone came by and picked up our dishes when we were finished and then we waited for about ten more minutes before our bill was brought to us. It was almost awkward how long we waited to get the bill. Again not especially busy. 

The food was good. No complaints about that. Not worth it though when you have to sit and wait so much. I'll drive to other Casa Mexico on Fairview even though it takes longer to get there. The service there is better.

Pretty good burgers.  I used the online ordering feature on Yelp.  It would have been better if I was informed that the order was ready rather than wondering.  The estimated time was 30 to 45 minutes even though I ordered at opening time.  I am sure my order was ready way before that but it would have been nice to be notified when the order was ready. Other than that, I highly recommend the burgers and sweet potato fries.  Delicious!!
Great food- great selection- great service. Food was great- we had several types of tacos and fajitas. Service was quick and food was hot!

Such bad attitude！！！Never order again！！！
Already pass estimate time 20 mins，and just answer me "not ready". Not even one more words.Then I ask can they go to check it in kitchen，they are very impatient.When they come back，just throw the bag to me without one word. I really can't believe it.
This is the 8th I order from them，but it's the first time I order less than 50dollars. I don't know if this is the reason. But it really horrible！！！The shrimp nir fresh and totally no taste.And before I got home, all the oil leaked out of the package.Even not more than 15mins. I will never order again.

Really friendly servers and great customer service throughout our meal. Our experience was five stars, between the customer service and the yummy flavors of the food. I wouldn't call this an upscale restaurant, but definitely five stars for casual dining.

The lunch portion sizes are on the larger side, very generous and great value for money. We opted for a lighter lunch, with a couple of nice salads. I recommend adding steak to the avocado salad. It was cooked exactly as I asked and had a really good flavor.

We were so full we only took a couple of bites of dessert but you can't not have cheesecake at Cheesecake Factory! The lemon-raspberry cheesecake wasn't too heavy and had a yummy zesty flavor from the lemon. I would definitely recommend for lemon lovers! Our leftovers were eaten within an hour of leaving!

the pizza is the best in philly.just get it plain and tell them well done which adds flavor.the cheese is better then alot of places.i hope the manager reads this and put out menus at nearby apartment buildings to get more customers.i will hate for this place to close down.advertisement is the key to a successful business and also take delivery orders up to 945pm mon to thurs and on friday and sat mainly should stay open til 11pm  and last delivery 1030pm and even if its slow you can still get maybe 10 more customers by phone calls or walk ins so dont close early
Great Latin food and very clean too. Love there cuban sandwich and pastries. Owners are very pleasant and good customer service
Excellent mussels and superior food.  Service a little slow.  Quiet, relaxing.  Perfect for a first date or romantic lunch.

Nice little gem in Metairie

Chef Duke does an excellent job.  The food was great and awesome selection of local draft beers.

We started with the fried green tomatoes.  Very delicious.  I had the Voodoo shrimp grits.  It included 6 jumbo shrimp with a spicy sweet sauce.  It was great.  My wife had the pasta jambalaya which had shrimp, chicken and sausage.  She truly enjoyed the sauce that was slightly spicy.

We had a great waitress that kept our drinks filled and was very friendly.

When we were walking out, we met Chef 
Duke.  He took our picture with Santa Claus the was dressed for Mardi Gras.  He called it Mardi Claus

I wanted to try this spot months ago, but it had some bad reviews on service previously. I'm so glad that was not our experience at all!

 My friends and I went last night. Our server Asem was AWESOME! She was very quick with refills and orders. Super nice and accommodated all our odd ticket split requests.
 
The drink choices and food were great too! For only $17 you can get a 60oz of Sangria pitcher which was perfect to split between 6 people. We also split the Pow Pow Shrimp, Cauliflower and curds, and cheese and sausage balls. All very tasty! My meal was the pork belly reuban with fries, luckily I still have half my sandwich for lunch today.

We'll definitely be back! Great place and excellent service that is following mask rules.
You can almost drive by this tasty diner without seeing it. Food was tasty and inexpensive. Lots of choices  for breakfast or brunch.  Service was efficient. Definitely would come back with guests.
None of the workers were wearing masks and were blocking the checkout area while watching tv. This was our go to place, but we will not be going back until they decide to take COVID-19 seriously.

Alright, as someone who lives in IV I am confronted with several options for pizza. I've done my rounds and i have finally came to the conclusion that Woodstock's is the spot. My girlfriend and I go there relatively often and the good atmosphere matches the food perfectly. We generally split a veggie pizza with vegan cheese and we've found that to be our go to. Awhile back ,her and I got into a conversation with a guy who suggested the cheese to us. Easily one of the best hacks in my opinion. That mixed with their Wednesday pint night is always a recipe for a good time. I will definitely be back again and can't recommend their food enough
Rudy's use to be delicious.. now rushed and greesy on more than a few occasions?? Hope management can get it back to a delicious spot again

Everything on the menu is so good! From the seafood platter to the dipping sauce on the side, everything, literally. 

The cotton candy pork is interesting, and tasty. The steak is excellent. The lamb is tender (sauce too salty for my liking). The desert is a must.

Perfect snapshot of Philly, the foods, produce, flowers, gifts, coffee and teas. It's all here. Beats the heck out of Pike's Place Market in Seattle (yes I've been along with markets from Perth to Hong Kong to Honolulu). It's a unique jewel in an otherwise bland, humorless glass and steel Center City Philly.

Great spot! I have heard and heard about this place but have not been until now.  First you order via screen and leave your phone number to receive a text when your order is ready. 

Tried spicy garlic chicken stir fry.  Very tasty.   The noodles were al dente,  sauce was generous and flavorful.   We had ordered extra sauce just in case but didn't need it.   Fresh chunks of vegetables and pineapple.  There was just a hint of heat,  which I loved!  Heat fresh, tasty,  quick bite perfect for lunch. 

Definitely would return to try something new.

Who knew Smokes offered more than late night sips at Sink or Swim? I recently came here for dinner with a group of friends and was pleasantly surprised. I absolutely loooved the onion and mushroom pie. The crust was perfectly crispy and the slices were huge. The only issue was with service. The bartender was a bit abrasive and it took multiple tries to order drinks/get water/tbh anything for the table. That said, I'd definitely recommend visiting if only to try their pizza...just manage your expectations for the quality of service.
Got a few macarons and a piece of cake. Every single bite tasted like the refrigerator it was stored in  Not only that but the cake was so dry. Really disappointed.

I finally got a chance to try @bestfriendscoffeebagels ! I was so impressed! 

I got a sugar free Carmel  macchiato. This coffee was the best coffee I have had in a long time ! 

I also got the son in law on a jalapeño cheddar bagel ! This sandwich has chorizo, cheddar cheese, egg, avocado, and salsa! It was so good even without the Avocado, but I def want to try it with it next time ! 

I can't wait to return and support this business in Brownsburg!

LBC is honestly pretty consistently good. I get the trip dip with guacamole 4 cheese spin and Buffalo chicken dip and it's absolutely amazing. The menu has nice variety and is creative. Have never had an issue with service there. So would recommend to try this out if u ever got some spare time

I went to a birthday party here and had a great time! There was a group of almost 20 of us and we had 2 servers that were just for us. They did a great job bringing out a steady stream of good food and drinks. It was a reasonable price for the selection of food that they gave us. The manager checked on us a couple times. I would highly recommend this location as they were very attentive and gave us a great experience at a great price!
Excellent restaurant amazing service! One of the best steakhouses I've been too. Staff was impeccable from start to finish. Looking forward to going back !

This isn't "good vegan food," it's good food without qualifiers. I'm not even a vegetarian, and I still find myself going back to Terron again and again. The menu offers enough variety that I think most people could find something they like, but some of my favorites are the bahn mi and the spicy Moroccan sandwich. The desserts are also really good, and I can't seem to stop myself from adding a cookie to every order. 

Although some dishes are a little on the pricy side, you're definitely paying for quality: the ingredients are always very fresh. Plus, most dishes are definitely big enough to share.

Ijji has become one of my go to restaurants when I come to Reno. Arrived here around 5:30pm for an early dinner to avoid any rush. Party of 3. We were seated immediately. The service here is on point! We ordered in rounds until we were completely full and could barely move. My favorites were the seasoned pork belly (seasoned with sesame oil, salt and pepper), and the ribeye steak. As far as ban chan goes, we kept ordering more cucumber salad. It was really addictive and fresh. Went really well with all the meat we ate. Wash everything down with some Korean seaweed soup and call it a day. I'll be back many more times in the future. Also get some soju! A Korean meal isn't complete without some soju!
Friendly staff, the food menu is smaller, but great variety of options from vegetarian to meat or pastry lovers. My omlete was well cooked with fresh and flavorful veggies.

You either get no hot sauce or you get a pound of hot sauce. Every time I've order the cinnamon twist they've had no flavor, no cinnamon at all. And the unsweetened tea taste like watered down tea, just not good. The tacos have always been pretty decent tho.

Wow! I can't believe it has taken me this long to try this place. It's delicious!! I was looking for a rice or noodle bowl with protein. Plugged it into Yelp and this place popped up. I've been wanting to try it since they opened. So, I decided to pop in for a takeout bowl. I went with the Jeyuk Top-Bab. Rice, Korean Spicy Pork (not super spicy, great flavor), carrots, broccoli, cauliflower, and a couple pieces of pot stickers. Added in the spicy Korean sauce....all delicious!! I also tried the super hot sauce. It was ok. Not super spicy and not a lot of flavor. The spicy Korean was delicious. Super friendly staff. Really can't say enough. Definitely 5 stars. Can't wait to come back after they reopen the dining room. It looks like it's normally a nice, relaxing lunch/dinner spot.

We dined on the table outside, and I'm not sure if we weren't supposed to but they served us just the same. This is the best fried chicken I have ever had. The chicken breast was so juicy I am replaying my first bite of it all the time. The staff is very loving and it shows in the way they took care of us. Would recommend 10/10 times to anyone coming to Nola.

The small hole in the walls mom and pops looking places are the best kind and this place just proves it. The churro is amazing the crunch and the sugar on the outside and the filling of caramel had me wanting more I had to put my taco down just to finish it. The tacos were good too very flavorful and meat super tender I would definitely come back to this place .

Incredible food, made with love. You can tell not only by the presentation and style but by the awesome flavors. I am so glad that my boyfriend could make reservation to celebrate my birthday eating food from my native country! Loquita (meaning crazy girl in case you didn't know:) totally hit the spot, food and mood wise. 

From the moment you enter, there are smiles and great treatment. Love the flooring, the simple yet chic decor, the delicate flowers on the tables, the mirror at the bar, the guy cutting the ham (both the ham and the jamonero looked really great!), the non strident flamenco dance black and white film projecting on the wall...and that fantastic patio full of art (absolutely adore the flowers painted in the walls, that is so my style, I used to paint flowers like that in my previous apartment complex just to decorate:). It was a perfect night in a perfect location with perfect chefs. 

We shares a bunch of tapas but the octopus was mine, mine and mine, although totally shareable. It was utterly delicious, tender, flavorful. The shrimp al ajillo (garlicky and tomato based) was superb. Pan con tomate awesome and crunchy...croquetas were perfection wrapped in jamon. The desserts were equally fantastic. It was a special night for me and I definitively 'me volvi loquita' (i became crazy, even if just temporary).
A group of 7 of us came for lunch, we were aMazed how qUickly the food came. The service was very attentive and staff was friendly. The calzones were amazing.

This is a fabulous spot for breakfast and lunch! With plenty of options on the menu from crabcakes Benedict,  to creme brulee French toast,  I have not been disappointed with anything I have eaten! The server was excellent the facilities clean and freshly decorated. I highly recommend this establishment for a great start to your day! Bravo,  Caleb!!

Had delivery that was 45" after promised. Food cold.  What not do that again 
Food tasty when reheated
Food is usually good here. Had the Italian beef and it was mostly fat. I would not recommend it. Server offered a free dessert but would not do anything about the bill.

Love this place - wonderful portions, excellent cuts and solid flavor. The atmosphere is conducive to good conversation and with it being BYO I find it to be excellent value. The staff is professional and pleasant - reservations highly recommended as there isn't a convenient place to wait.

This is really a nice restaurant with an interesting menu. I love that it has vegetarian options for those who seek to eat a plant based diet. I would give it five stars if it weren't for two issues we encountered on our last visit. First, the spicy cauliflower rice dish was TOO spicy. I mean I like spice, but this was challenging even for me. The dish was great otherwise. Ask the chef to dial it down and you won't be disappointed. Second, the small  Israel couscous stuffed squash was a tad lonely looking on the plate even on the bed of greens. You might consider ordering a side dish if you're hungry as you'll be too tempted to get desert and undo to benefit of eating plant based in the first place.

Incredibly disappointed. Since they have opened back up I've come once if not twice a week with a previous 5 star rating (which I just changed) . Went for dinner tonight and it was FREEZING. We asked 3 people to bring a heater or increase the heat. Nothing happened. Yet I saw the same person go and help move heaters closer to other tables and change the gas when it ran low. Food as always is good but entire experience was eh because it was so cold .Plus with the rise of COVID cases I discourage indoor dining in general. Might give it another try at some point but not in the near future. On a positive note, best Shepard pie I've had in Philly. Plus kept all the pics from our previous dining experience because the food is good.

High expectations - but the food was good. The service however, ugh!!!

Went in for lunch alone, watched others who came in after me get served first, server seemed frazzled, was told " we are really busy" when wondering where my food was, mind you, I think only 6 tables were in my area with 2 servers.

Wasn't asked how my food was... asked for my check and an extra tortilla to go since I had to leave for a meeting before I could finish... never got. Check was left but had to get up and walk to the front to get servers attention to pay. Maybe she was new, but really need to step it up with service.

This is honestly a pathetic excuse for a restaurant.. no one answers calls , even after completely ruining your order . Rude , genuinely worst customer service I've ever experienced . Food literally tasted like a burnt shoe. Honestly horrible

The food was ok, but the order was wrong.  I ordered two 5" tuna subs.  The young man who took the order (TreyVaughn), took the order correctly, but they got it wrong in the back.
When I got home and took the subs out, one was tuna and one was turkey or something that looked like turkey.
My wife was very disappointed.  I tried to call and let them know they got the order wrong but they never answered after two attempts (once at 7:40 PM and once at 8:19 PM).

Love this place. Dining in has never been an issue as their menu is huge (I usually end up ordering the same favorite things) however I've had a few issues whenever I've done the pickup option so I usually just opt to dine in. The wheat bread never disappoints
The best bbq eel and Sushi in the area, rice cooked perfectly, Service was really good and, the place was Very clean.

Favorite restaurant in St. Louis. The food menu is constantly changing and has never let us down. We like picking and choosing multiple things to share and this is the place to do it. Food and drinks are both next level!

Fantastic! The wait staff was friendly and attentive, servers other than our own stopped in to check on us, and they were pretty fast.

The soup was good but a bit overpriced. The spinach artichoke dip was heavier on the veggies and lighter on the cheese, which was a big plus for us. The chips were fresh and very crispy! They were dusted in Old Bay or some equivalent and it went well with the food. The burger was nice, just a tad dry, and I wasn't the biggest fan of the bun, but the seasonings were totes on point!

If you're in the area I definitely recommend giving them a try.

If you want a quality BLIZZARD please don't come to this location, They only fill them 3/4 of the way and not filling them all the way like all other locations! I thought this was a fluke experience but after being screwed 3 times, clearly this is the nickel and dime standard for this location! Most Dairy Queens overflow their BLIZZARDS, not these cheapskates! Bye Felicia Queen!
Great food - chicken paprika was delicious!   Definitely  tastes like my grandmother made.    It won't disappoint

What a delightful find! Our family dinner at Marsilio's was an excellent experience--from the attentive and friendly staff to the exquisite food. Highly recommend the gnocchi, the meatball, all the sauces, and the eggplant parmesan. House made sangria was a nice cap to the last weekend of the summer. Thank you, Matt, Christian, and all the team that made our meal a fantastic, tasting adventure.

Awful customer service! I complained to a Costa Vida employee and they gave me an email and basically said it wasn't their problem. Everyone was rude. They can't get an order right. Management never replied.

I want to thank this market for being such a pillar in the community, particularly as I write during a difficult time (COVID-19 pandemic). The market has stayed open, has remained as stocked as possible, has made visible efforts to sanitize carts and provide a hygienic environment, and has taken on responsibility for various community things like CSA pick-ups. While not everything at this store is the most affordable, I am thankful to have this place right here in the neighborhood and know that, through thick and thin, they will be here. Thank you to all the staff and management who show up every single day for us!!
The food was awesome and the staff was amazing with suggestions and patience for first timers. I plan on visiting again!!!
They're great. Huge portions and a great variety   of selections.    I've only done delivery with them.  You wouldn't  expect it but their fried chicken wings are delicious.

Checked this out this morning while looking for a new brunch place in town (also I've really been craving waffles recently). The place was obviously still very new. Some of the owners were sitting at a table when we walked in and no one was at the counter. We were greeted promptly though and someone helped us out with our order at the counter. 

The decor is fairly eclectic and hasn't quite found its niche yet. The space feels clean and bright which is great but doesn't have a consistent tone and feels a bit strewn together. The bar is the obvious centerpiece of the room and looks a bit overstocked for a brunch-focused place (though it does seem that they are open until 11 pm to take advantage of the late night crowd in the Grove). Would love to see a more consistent color scheme and some cozier looking furniture. (3/5 for decor)

I really liked offerings on the menu. It was focused but had good variety and none of the dishes looked over-the-top. All the flavor schemes looked intriguing but simple. Perfect for a spot like this. (5/5 for menu) 

Our host/server was excellent. Obviously very experienced with customer service and familiar with the menu and restaurant (which is great to see at a place that just opened up). The restaurant is order at the bar and get a number for your table. So there isn't a lot of interaction but she still came over to check up on us and clear our empty plates. The apparent owner/manager who was sitting around also came over and made sure everythi

Took my family here for prime rib and it did not disappoint!  Huge cuts of prime rib, nice and pink and delicious. We also had their fried chicken- which takes a while for them to make from scratch, but it is really worth it. It is pricy- but you get a lot of food for your money.

Great place. Been coming here for about a year. It seems every month they put more money into the place to make it look nice. Jake and Megan are the best. Always a smile and happy to serve. The best part is the food. Great food on the water with nice people. Doesn't get better than that!!!

It's a very cute place, lots of outside seating and you don't even need to go inside right now to order. It's very instagram friendly. I had an ice cream cone.  The matcha was really good but the chocolate was just so so. I think the chocolate has more of a dark chocolate flavor or something. The cone was good but it kind of fell a apart before I was even close to being done so I wouldn't do that again. 
Overall good experience.

Hand pies are out of this world. I was walking around this area and got some hand pies from here and they were so good, they stayed on my mind. I forgot where the place was for a while but I didn't forget the hand pies, and I finally found it again! Highly recommended.

Have been coming here for about 7 years. The whiskey bar upstairs has become a special place for my best friend and I. The very few negative experiences that we've had here have always been immediately corrected. Will remain a loyal customer for a long time.
I thought  this place was good - so many choices. The passion fruit guava drink had seeds in it and I didn't like that but the tai tea drink was bomb ! Will have to go back and try more flavors !

Cheese steaks  are great, however I come here for their roast pork. This is my runner up for best roast pork in south philly. The lines move quickly and sometimes seating is a pain ( especially if it is a busy sports night). However you can stand around and once someone gets up make your move!! He owner tony is a really great guy and well and does a lot for the community. Food taste better when the owner isn't a weirdo. I suggest the Italian pork and cheese fries!!

It's official... I've found another favorite breakfast spot in La Segunda Bakery & Cafe. My husband and I are constantly in search of the best breakfast sandwiches. We also love Cuban bread and pressed sandwiches. Because we live in Pinellas (on the other side of the bride), we don't get to venture into Tampa to check out their cuisine often. Up until yesterday, I didn't know La Segunda had a second location about 20 minutes from our home. After this discovery, I knew I had to check it out. 

They offer convenient online ordering and payment for take out or curbside. We ordered ahead and everything was ready in about 15-20 minutes. You can get the Cuban breakfast sandwich by itself or as a combo with a drink. I ordered the egg breakfast sandwich with cheese and spinach, and my husband got his the same way with crispy bacon (no additional charge). With the combo, you can pick from drinks including a cafe con leche, latte, cappuccino, cold brew, etc. I selected the cafe con leche and upgraded it to a larger size for $1 more. My husband got an iced mocha latte. 

When we got home to try everything, it looked amazing! I've had other cafe con leche drinks before where the coffee tasted bland or weak. The one at La Segunda was perfect! I also thoroughly enjoyed the breakfast sandwich with the best Cuban bread--a little crusty on the outside after it was pressed, yet soft on the inside. It was a delightful breakfast!

I am sad that I didn't discover this earlier, but now that I've f

If you're looking for a salad, good grief go to a salad store. This place is about Pizza. Not just any pizza but a style of pizza prepared in a way that most people around here aren't used to if they've ever even heard of it. 
This is Pizza in the style of Naples, sort of. It's New York style Pizza. Years ago I was in New York and 1 thing you want to do in New York is go try some of the great, traditional pizzas. Grimaldi's is one of those and it's one of the originals. There's Lombardi's, Rays, Grimaldi's and a handful of others. The thing that makes them special besides the pizza is the cooking. COAL FIRED BRICK OVENS, that's right coal. So if you're of "the woke" persuasion, just go to Domino's and eat the box. This place ain't for you.
This was a place, where the line was too long to get in when I was last in New York City... kinda like Lombardi's.. the lines are long because of their long history and colossal reputation for the best ingredients.
This is a New York style, thin crust pizza, that is best done with simplicity in mind. Just one or two toppings is the way to go. I love their pepperoni pizza, or a simple sausage and mushroom. No Hawaiian, no tofu, just the finest quality pepperoni on a delicious thin crust and cooked in a traditional coal fired oven. The coal oven is key! So before you turn up your nose because your salad wasn't perfect, or because you want to shut down the coal industry and hate the idea of anyone using coal, remember what you went there for..
What can I say. It was wonderful food,  service was great and my meal was outstanding . It was an event that I'll never forget. Must go back again!!
Great experience on a quick visit to StL. The server and staff were so friendly and helpful. Solid menu with good starter options, good beer choices and good pizza menu. Would highly recommend!

So it's New Year's day and there might be 9 tables all together. Have NEVER been to a diner with worse service.  Here 15 minutes and no beverages: A coffee and tomato juice. WTF? 20 minutes later food comes- still no beverages and when waitress was reminded- states she forgot about it. This will be reflected in your gratuity sister.  

finally... beverages arrive.  coffee i never ordered and no tomato juice.  Are you kidding me?

We ventured to downtown St. Pete tonight and gave Joey Brooklyn's a shot. This place is NY style in every way. Its small commercial footprint with just enough space to order reminds me of trips to the city. It does have a few picnic tables out front you can use for "dining in" if you like. Unfortunately, it was raining on our visit so only one table was a legit option.

On the plus side, we shared the table with another family and had some great conversation. If you go after 9p on a Saturday like we did, you get the added bonus of world class people-watching as they stammer in and out of the adjacent bars. It was a total win.

Janus Landing had a band playing so we had that going on in the background as well, adding to the ambiance. 

Our pizza took about 25 minutes to come out, not too bad for as busy as they were. Staff was friendly.

Pizza was better than average but it's hard to give it 5 stars. Had we been bar hopping I'm guessing we have scored it different, but being wet from rain and stone cold sober it was a solid 4.5 experience.

These Yelp reviews led me astray with this place here. Is this what is considered good Chinese around here?! I ordered wonton soup, shrimp fried rice and fried wings. 

Let's start with the soup. The wontons were huge but were mainly wrapper dough and not much filling and the filling had a weird taste. Fried rice with shrimp was ok and the fried wings were not even crunchy and half cooked. 

My biggest gripe is that no utensils, Soy sauce or even napkins provided. 

I'll have to continue my search for good Chinese around here.

This is going to be short and sweet... I really liked the food, great portions and I have no complaints. 
The only negative and its more of an observation than a negative is the decor is stuck in the 50s or 60s but one could argue it adds to the authenticity of the place. 
I had the vegetarian breakfast; as a person who doesn't like eggs it's sometimes hard to find a good breakfast when you eat out that doesn't have eggs in it, and it was great see pic!

We ordered there steak fries and it tasted like the meat was cooke with charcoal and the steak felt like it wasn't cooked all the way it was so sloppy and absolutely disgusting!!! Don't go here for steak fries!!!

This is the worse Taco Bell I've ever been too. The people that work there are absolutely disgusting. They honestly look like they don't shower, their clothes it's always dirty. They are always scratching their heads and picking their nose and they never EVER clean the place. On top of all this the food taste disgusting and they are rude and lazy. Please don't go to this place. I don't know what it is about Olsen ave in Ewing it seems like they all dirty and have attitudes and laziness. Too bad for economy and people's health

Want a fantastic spot for breakfast, with fantastic omelets? Squeeze In is the place to be. Huge servings and a wide variety of choices. Wonderfully cooked and served by friendly staff. Every time I am in Reno, I make sure to head over for my Squeeze In breakfast fix.

Absolute crap service, mediocre food. We ordered through a delivery service and we got a call from the driver (who was wonderful, btw) when he was about 3 minutes away from us. The restaurant had called him to say they had given him the wrong order. Okay, we get that, mistakes happen; he went back to get our order. When he finally got ours to us it was missing half of the large sushi/sashimi special we ordered. We called right away and were told we could come to pick it up or wait another hour for delivery. We opted for pick up. When we got there we were given what was supposed to be the rest of the special; turns out the shorted us AGAIN. And no offer of any compensation for the trouble this whole mess caused us.
The shrimp lettuce wrap was tasteless, miso soup looked like dishwater and the fried rice wasn't fried, just had brown sauce on it to look fried. Save yourself.

First of all I received cold food as the order arrived an hour late because of Yelp/Grubhub address error. I ordered baked falafel pita and Mediterranean trip bowl with falafel. Falafel were way undercooked and raw in the center. Sauces lacked flavor and pita bread was thick too. Roasted veggies that came as side of falafel pita were the only good thing in the meal.

I have been to this place twice. The first time was just awful. I decided to give it another try. No better. The bow buns have a Swedish meatball inside. Seriously it's a meatball and tastes like one from the frozen section at the Kroger next-door.

Food: 4.25 Out of 5
Steak quesadilla and carnitas tacos had the right flavors. Carnitas had nice texture, but the steak had a little more gristle than I expected. Their red sauce had more chipotle flavor and the salsa verde was par.

Environment and Service: 4.25 Out of 5
Small hole in the wall joint. Seats no more than 20 people. Pretty slow when I came to order to go, my goodies were ready in about 10 minutes.

Overall: 4.25 Out of 5
No doubt I'm coming back when I need a Mexican food fix

First Time Dining At This Restaurant ! I Gave 5 Stars Because Of The Welcoming Environment, Great Service By (Rachel) & Very Delicious Sushi ! 

The Cleanliness Of This Entire Establishment Is 100% On Point. As A Former Operations Manager From One Of The Darden Brand Restaurants, I Always Make Time To Shine Some Light Of ANY Businesses That Continue To Strive For Excellence Everyday.

Small local joint serving fresh authentic Mediterranean cuisine and deli sandwiches. The gyros were served hot and flavorful.  Their cucumber sauce was creamy and delicious and I really could have used more on my chicken gyro.  The Mediterranean salad is huge and of crisp vegetables topped with feta and a tasty balsamic vinaigrette.  The best part of my meal was the baklava.  It was sweet,  spicy,  satisfying, and dripping in honey.  I  really should have ordered more than one piece.  I highly recommend this place.  The staff is friendly and welcoming and the menu is full of delicious food at a great price!

Very delicious. Huge portions. I recommend going with a group and sharing. We got popcorn chicken, boiled beef, fatty beef, bok choy, dumplings in chili oil, egg rolls, dandan noodles, and too many Tsing Taos to count. Between 5 of us we were able to finish most of it. My only complaint is that the popcorn chicken was super oily. Well definitely be back!!

Highly recommend the Baja Fish Tacos!
Outdoor seating available. Tables are disinfected are each customer.  Clean bathrooms. Friendly staff.

Food was good , nothing special . Menu lack depth and options . The food cater  to its surrounding office worker residents.  Service was fast and honest. Might been  best Mexican food in this area , but not the best Mexican food if you had another option . Wouldn't  go out of my way to dine here , but a decent place .

In town from Texas and made reservations for dinner. Called to find out the dress code and was told that the only thing they did not allow was open toed shoes. My boyfriend wore a pressed button up shirt, nice shorts and loafer style shoes because we had been hot all day and did not want to wear jeans. We paid for a 20 minute Uber from the Gaylord Opryland hotel and got turned away and told we had to eat at the bar because he was in shorts even thought he still looked very nice. We left. If you have a dress code, make sure anyone answering the phone knows that dress code. I understand keeping a standard however we were given the wrong information and treated poorly because of their error.

This is a nice smoothie spot. I know they have multiple locations I have been to the armature works and soho one. 

Smoothies: excellent. Seem to have good ingredients and taste is great. No one ingredient is overwhelming but each has a nice texture. I like their addition/customization options too.

Acai bowl: not my favorite but I know others that like it. 

Clean, place. They do take covid precautions.
I enjoyed this place, will be back. 
I recommend the liquid gold smoothie

We sat rooftop & it was beautiful up there. Food, drinks, service & atmosphere were top notch. This is owned by the same group who created Osteria and Franklin Manor, Nocturnal. They are constantly raising the bar. This is a must see!

Vin De Set was an excellent experience in attribute to a few reasons. First, the atmosphere is beautiful and feels like the guest has left stl. The outdoor seating area has breathtaking views and comforting lighting. The food was to die for and is something I continue to bring up even though the visit was months ago. Our waiter was a delight and had excellent suggestions and small talk.

Now is the time to support your local businesses! This is a great place to go to for decent Thai food if you are in the area. Given the current situation, I decided to get a to go order and, let me tell you, the food did not disappoint!! =) I decided to get the Tom Yum Fried Rice, which is a fried rice that has both hot and sour flavors. For only around $10, you get an entire large takeout box filled with fried rice! This place probably gives you the best value for a lunch special ever! They also did not skimp on the protein. This fried rice was filled with well seasoned and tender pieces of pork. On top of that, you also get a crispy spring roll that goes with your lunch special. Service from order to pick up is incredibly quick and efficient. My order took about 15 minutes to complete. So if you want a lot of food for a cheap price, and the added bonus of supporting local business, come here!

We had an hour before we wanted dinner & wanted some good pizza so we were excited to drop $35 on a pie from Santucci's. 1 hr 10 minutes later and  I'm preheating the oven  because our pizza was barely cooked. Aside from a little on the very top layer of cheese, the rest is cold and limp. There are darker looking spots near the meat but that's from the blood pulling from the not cooked steak. It's like they threw it under a broiler until the cheese by the edges browned, threw it in the box, and figured it was DoorDash's problem. Pic #1 isn't melted cheese but a bit of raw dough. #2 shows the "browning" courtesy of the rare steak they threw on  the raw pizza.

Sandwich was great... customer service needs to be worked on! Wasn't acknowledged for at least 5 minutes when i came in to pick up my online order and there was no other customers in there. If i wouldn't have paid online i would've just left

Seated quickly but Really long wait for cold food  (others seated after us got served food before us) that  the plates hotter than the food.totally disappointed in the food. server was very nice tho. i dont think im coming back dennys is better

The food was okay, but I thought it could've been better. It was my first time at Fuddruckers, and I enjoyed the atmosphere inside. I got a burger with chili and a hotdog. It was okay, but not great. I'm just glad that I went and now I know how their burgers taste.

This was my first time at a any of the Han Dynasty restaurants,  this one happen to be BYOB.. I looked at the website prior to going, I don't recall that being noted. Luckily my friend called ahead and found out it was BYOB so she picked up some wine.  
The food was very good and I liked that you could give them a heat/spice range, unfortunately they didn't follow it. My delicious had a 1 heat range and it was spice, my friend, who loves spicy food asked for her dish to be 5 instead of the noted in the menu 8. Her fish was sooo good but way to spicy for me and even gave her some challenges.  
Also they didn't bring a wine chiller. 
I look forward visiting another Han Dynasty.

Good food at Drakes. The cheesesteak egg rolls were good and the burgers were cooked to order and quite good 
Racer 5 was a pretty good IPA also.
We will return when back in town.

Benko Burger ..... Is Delicious. 
One of the best burgers. 
Fries that accompany the burger were just okay (too oily).
$14 burger on the Bar bites menu. 

Blueberry lemon drop cocktail drink - was bleh... the BoneFish one is wayyyyyyy better. 

Spiced Old Fashioned drink was soooo cool - felt like I was in a James Bond Movie (especially since they had really nice live music.... )

Go and Happy hour. Ends at 7pm on Saturday.
The most bad to mediocre food with the most smug to neutral service. My breakfast reminded me of the Big Breakfast at McDonalds. I would say it's worth $3.99 but not a dime more.

We went for their STL Taco Week specials which were so yummy!! We also got their other two tacos which are normally on the menu for Tuesday's. We started with the Garlic Shrimp appetizer (I think that's the one, hahah) and it was delicious! The reason for the 4 star review was that our server was pretty slow and took a while to get back to us with drinks and to take our order. However, the busser was very attentive and friendly.

Save yourself the time and go to the other Seed location in the city. There were only three of us and our entire meal took over two hours. On top of that, we had the absolute worst service. I got the waffle and tofu nuggets and my waffle was so ridiculously hard that it was inedible. Once we told this to our waitress, her response was "well some people aren't used to gluten free food". No offer to replace it, no sympathy, nothing to rectify my dissatisfaction and I'll add that I am quite used to gluten free food. I honestly doubt she would have even taken it off our bill if we didn't ask. This is our first time going to this location and I can assure you it will be the last.

This is what I call authentic. I'm from California, so I appreciate the Tex Mex we eat in the US, but NOTHING can compare to authentic Mexican food, it's something I miss about being on the coast. Luckily, I've found this place. If you really think Tex mex is true Mexican food, this is NOT the place for you. I'm talking homemade corn tortillas with fresh meat traditionally prepared, onions, and cilantro. They have other options (enchiladas, Torres, etc), but these tacos are as real and delicious as they come around here. It looks like a little hole in the wall, but I'm telling you, it's the best Mexican food you'll probably find in the whole state. Don't let the outside scare you because they are the most warm and welcoming people, walk in and you're instantly family. Great experience, great food. You have to try it.
